selection.name: C04 — gpt-oss-20b
selection.role: Finalist for the single fallback-model slot; strongest documented serving and agent-client route among the reviewed sources. No measured winner is established.
selection.install_command:
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b
ollama run gpt-oss:20b
selection.install_source: Model commands: openai/gpt-oss@7b583341fe16729127f6d5b94a7b09ccae97e1a1, README.md#ollama. Linux runtime installer: ollama/ollama, README.md, Git blob e511fbe3fd3e73fc6d7cfb5393d827cf70f0a2f6, retrieved 2026-10-02.

basis.shows: Upstream documents native function calling and Structured Outputs, and reports operation within 16 GB of memory using native MXFP4. This is an upstream footprint claim, not a measured RTX 4090 result with an embedding model resident.

Provides a Codex configuration using an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint and Ollama. Also documents vLLM serving and a partial reference Responses API server. Apple Silicon Metal inference exists but is described as not production-ready.

Documents the Linux installer, macOS installation, and integrations with Claude Code and Codex. Retrieved README Git blob: e511fbe3fd3e73fc6d7cfb5393d827cf70f0a2f6. These recipes were not exercised on the target host.
Repository is unarchived. Apache-2.0 license is information only.
Latest default-branch commit is 2026-07-24, inside the 90-day window.
Latest GitHub release is v0.0.9, published 2026-01-13, outside the 90-day window.

selection.name: C02 — Granite 4.2 — 3B, 8B and 30B
selection.role: Alternative finalist using the 8B variant for the same single-model slot; target-server integration remains a qualification gate.
selection.install_command:
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio
pip install accelerate transformers
selection.install_source: ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models@75355e6ef8c17d72a7b3736654ab525352f5e0b8, README.md, Quick Start Inference Examples with Transformers / Installation. These commands install the documented inference dependencies; they are not a complete OpenAI-server recipe.

basis.shows: Documents OpenAI function-definition schemas, tool calling with integrated reasoning, and multi-turn tool responses. Nominal 8B BF16 weights imply approximately 16 GB by parameter-count arithmetic, before caches and runtime allocations. That estimate is an inference; actual GPU residency was not measured.

IBM's published chart reports Granite 4.2 8B scores of 52.4 on BFCL v4, 79.3 on IFBench, 73.2 on LiveCodeBench v6, and 86.7 on AIME25. It does not compare gpt-oss-20b or Gemma 4 E4B IT and does not establish the required RTX 4090 performance with an embedding model loaded.
Repository is unarchived. Apache-2.0 license is information only.
Latest default-branch commit is 2026-09-15, inside the 90-day window. The releases/latest API returned HTTP 404, so no latest GitHub Release was credited.

not_selected.name: Gemma 4 E4B IT
not_selected.reason: JAX sampling and successful pytest jobs are verified, but exact E4B IT tool/schema evaluation and OpenAI-server operation remain unverified; the README's older 2B/7B memory guidance cannot establish E4B fit. [Pinned README](https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemma/blob/c490becf42d1/README.md), [pytest result](https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemma/actions/runs/36687621683/job/109797001920).

not_selected.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B / Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B
not_selected.reason: NVIDIA reports a 22 GB Lightning NVFP4 checkpoint, suggesting tight capacity for embedding, caches and runtime; Nano's small active-parameter count does not establish small resident weights. Neither reviewed path establishes the required shared-GPU fit. [Lightning guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron/blob/8749344f8cce/docs/nemotron/lightning35/README.md), [Nano documentation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron/blob/8749344f8cce/README.md).

not_selected.name: Qwen3.8-27B
not_selected.reason: The documented vLLM example uses four GPUs, while GGUF and Apple Silicon guidance still refers to Qwen3.5; exact 3.8-27B quantized tool/schema quality and memory on one RTX 4090 remain unverified. [Pinned README](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3.8/blob/2ea10dc72582/README.md).

not_selected.name: GLM-4-32B-0414
not_selected.reason: Upstream measured 68 GB GPU memory at BF16 with 1,000 input tokens on an H100, exceeding the target in that configuration; quantization could still qualify, but its target-host reliability was not established. [Inference benchmark](https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-4/blob/024d8fd48e62/inference/README.md).

layers.deciding_comparison: The selections are alternatives for one model slot, not a complementary installation set. Compare gpt-oss-20b in its deployed MXFP4 representation against Granite 4.2 8B through one pinned OpenAI-compatible server supporting both exact chat templates and tool parsers, on a clean WSL2 Ubuntu / RTX 4090 host. Keep the same embedding model GPU-resident and match context length, batching and output budget. Measure strict JSON-schema validity, correct tool selection and arguments, multi-turn tool completion, public BFCL v4 performance, answer quality on a fixed public reasoning-benchmark subset, prefill/decode tokens per second, latency and peak GPU memory; report CPU offload. Include Gemma 4 E4B IT as a compact challenger if its exact serving path can be verified. Choose one model after this comparison establishes the best reliable fallback within the shared GPU budget.
evidence_gaps: Judgment date: 2026-10-02; 90-day cutoff: 2026-07-04. All six repositories are unarchived and have current default-branch commits: gpt-oss 2026-07-24, Granite 2026-09-15, Gemma 2026-09-30, Nemotron 2026-09-11, Qwen 2026-08-17 and GLM 2026-08-05. These are repository commit dates, not model-weight update dates. Nemotron's later pushed_at timestamp was not substituted for its default-branch commit date.

None of the returned latest GitHub Release dates falls inside the 90-day window: gpt-oss v0.0.9 on 2026-01-13, Gemma v4.0.1 on 2026-05-20 and Nemotron v0.1.0 on 2026-03-24. Granite, Qwen and GLM releases/latest returned HTTP 404. Separately, Qwen's README reports the 27B weight release on 2026-08-14, inside the window.

Latest issue updates from the GitHub health query were recent for every repository: gpt-oss 2026-10-02, Granite 2026-09-19, Gemma 2026-10-01, Nemotron 2026-10-02, Qwen 2026-09-30 and GLM 2026-09-21. Issue-update dates establish report activity, not maintainer response speed or defect resolution.

At Gemma's checked head, two pytest jobs succeeded but the publish job failed: [pytest](https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemma/actions/runs/36687639337/job/109797061459), [publish](https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemma/actions/runs/36687639337/job/109798637528). Nemotron's returned success rollup contained only a skipped request job. The other four checked heads returned no status rollup. This does not establish comparative model or inference test coverage.

No verified target-host measurement establishes structured-output reliability, tool-call success, throughput or peak memory with an embedding model loaded. The embedding model and laptop memory capacities are unspecified. Numerical gpt-oss, exact Gemma E4B and Qwen3.8 model-card quality results were not credited without reading their primary evaluations.

Granite's dependency installation and tool examples do not establish a complete target-server recipe; its model-download example also contains a https://https:// URL typo. macOS arm64 serving and tool/schema reliability remain unverified for the exact Granite, Gemma, Nemotron, Qwen3.8 and GLM variants. gpt-oss documents Apple Silicon reference Metal inference but labels it not production-ready.
